ModMetaData.name: Project Mamono Reptiles
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Adds eleven reptile mamonos to RimWorld 1.6, and two realms of the mountains to live in.
Serpent-tailed hunters and talkers, dragon-kin who fly and feel no fire, cave tunnellers, swordmasters and one swamp brute: every one has her own body, her own hide and her own place in the world. Two mountain realms live beside them, one neutral and trading and one always at war.
A reptilian body gives her tough scales, a love of heat, a single egg in place of a live birth, and a hide she sheds once a year. Cold cannot kill her: it slows her, then puts her to sleep until she is warm again.
Dragonian traders bring a violet metal, lamps that call a wild dragon, wedding collars and a strong red wine. Dark blood remakes a woman into a dragonewt, and a dragonewt into a malef dragon.
In game you meet them as raiders at your door, as wild women you can tame, as traders, and as women you take in. Every one butchers into the family's own meat, and her corpse gives her own hide.
Requires Harmony, Biotech, Project Mamono, Big and Small - Framework, and Vanilla Expanded Framework.
